summary: Frontend smoke and interaction testing completed for FILEFORGE home, directory, search, utilities, settings, and mobile menu.

integration_issues.issue: Mobile menu link is generated as /all-tools, but the router only defines /tools. Clicking it falls back to the home page instead of opening the directory.

action_items: Change mobile All Tools href to /tools (and verify mobile menu routes).
Implement or explicitly scope core processing for the remaining non-utility tools; current generic processing returns a text placeholder rather than performing PDF/image/video conversion.
critical_code_review_comments: ToolPage uses one generic setTimeout + text Blob for most of the 33 tools, so file processing/download is not real functionality for PDF, image, video, and converter tools despite the product requirement.
Home upload immediately records history as Merge PDF regardless of the selected file or actual processing; this can create misleading history entries before processing occurs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop home, 33-card directory, category counts (10/8/15), directory search, global search routing, password generator, word counter, JSON formatter, Base64 encode, no-file processing state, and settings toggle passed. Mobile All Tools route failed. File-upload processing and clear-history persistence were not executed in this run.
rca of the issue: Navbar constructs mobile links using label.toLowerCase().replace(' ','-'), producing /all-tools; App routes the directory at /tools. The wildcard route then renders Home, hiding the navigation failure. Fix with an explicit label-to-path map.
